description: This PHP source file provides utility functions for handling currency conversions and saving feature within the AOS_Products_Quotes module of SuiteCRM. It includes functions to perform save operations, fetch currency data, and determine if a value is from the database.

methods.name: perform_aos_save
methods.description: Performs save operations for AOS_Products_Quotes, converting specified currency fields to dollar values using the currency object.

methods.name: fetch_aos_currency
methods.description: Retrieves the Currency bean associated with the focus object, with fallback logging if currency_id is not set.

methods.name: amountToConvertIsDatabaseValue
methods.description: Determines whether a given field's value matches its fetched database value, indicating if it's a database value.
